top_signals.title: CPC Terminal to Resume Kazakh Oil Exports After Drone Pause
top_signals.summary: The main terminal for exporting Kazakhstan’s oil is set to resume loadings after drone attacks on vessels caused an output cut last week, a step that may help to ease one of the market’s major supply worries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
